Responsibilities include:

· Design, develop and install new and efficient network and systems architecture, applications, databases and servers

· Evaluate and provide recommendations on ways network and system operations and hardware can be improved and optimised

· Consistently monitor network and system activities, capacities and usage to maintain reliability and optimise performance for users

· Rectify network problems and emergencies in a professional, skilled and timely manner

· Offer network programming which will support the needs and requirements to meet organisational specifications

· Analyse, configure and monitor network infrastructure to ensure networks and systems are operating effectively and at a high level of performance.

· Ensure appropriate procedures and documentation methods are in place to record network inventory, problems and their resolutions, any updates or modifications, and instructions on maintaining a business's technical networks and systems.

· Assist and provide recommendations on the development, integration and installation of systems and networks by analysing and evaluating system and network designs, architecture requirements, models and diagrams.

· monitoring network traffic, and activity, capacity and usage to ensure continued integrity and optimal network performance

As successful candidate will be able to design, develop, maintain, configure and provide support for network and system hardware. They will be required to investigate, analyse, test and make recommendations to users regarding opportunities and strategies to optimise technical networks and systems.

The successful candidate will have:

-A minimum of 1 years experience in the field

-Excellent verbal and written communication skills the ability to prioritize and successfully complete projects.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an IT Operations Engineer to join our National Operations Centre (NOC) team. We are seeking candidates with a strong background in IT systems and networks, coupled with extensive experience in managing IT service desk operations, and providing high-level support to internal and external staff. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in collaborating with various IT teams, ensuring the delivery of high-quality services to the business, while striving for operational excellence.

Please note this will be a permanent, full-time role based out of our Sydney CBD Office. It will involve participation in a continuous shift roster - working 4 days on and 4 days off. The shift patterns will be made up of 2-day shifts from 7am-7pm and 2-night shifts from 7pm-7am. 

Some of your responsibilities will include and are not limited to
•	Monitoring critical business services and systems, networks and infrastructure
•	Provide after-hours service desk support to users
•	Identify and address issues before they affect business operations
•	Handle and administer privileged accounts securely

What you’ll have done
•	Seasoned service desk analyst, NOC or equivalent experience (minimum 2 years), ideally in a continuous shift operations centre (24/7x365)
•	Strong technical knowledge of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, SNMP, DNS, DHCP, and other networking protocols
•	Strong problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues quickly, including experience with major incidents
•	Familiarity with server operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux) and basic server administration
•	Experience with technology service monitoring tools - systems, application, and networks such as Centreon, Solarwinds, PTRG desirable
•	Familiarity with IT service management tools and frameworks (ITIL v3/4)
•	Demonstrated experience in delivering exemplary support, customer service and training
•	Excellent documentation skills for keeping records of issues, resolutions, and operational procedures
•	Effective communication with the ability to work as part of a team, especially in a high-pressure environment where collaboration is essential to solving issues

What we can offer you
•	5 weeks annual leave 
•	Annual salary between 90,000 - 95,000
•	Opportunities to progress within I-MED’s continued growth and expansion 
•	Being part of a team that makes a difference to the functioning of our ever-growing business 
•	Experience in communicating with different areas of IT 
•	Enjoy exclusive benefits including discounted private health insurance, salary packaging, Fitness Passport access, lifestyle and travel discounts, I-MED services for your family and employee wellbeing support.

About Us
At I-MED, we're more than just a medical imaging provider - we're a community of passionate professionals committed to excellence for our patients. With over 200 clinics and a staggering 6 million patient procedures annually, we proudly stand as one of the largest providers of medical imaging in the world. Our success lies in our people with over 350 dedicated doctors and 4,000 staff members who actively share clinical knowledge and expertise. 

If you're looking for the next step in your career and are passionate about the delivery of excellence within healthcare services, apply today!

result.description:
Field Service Technician
Premier Tech Systems and Automation Pty Limited
Full-time
130,000 – $140,000 (inclusive of guaranteed allowances) + super

The company

As part of the well-respected and successful international Premier Tech group, and with an
Australian history dating back to the 1950’s, we are a leader within the bulk handling and
packaging equipment industry in Australia.  We are collaborative and innovative, and we love
what we do.

The role

As part of a national team of field service technicians servicing and commissioning a range of
specialised flexible packaging machinery installed around the country and abroad, you will
travel extensively (approx. 75% of the role) throughout metro and regional VIC, as well as
interstate and the occasional international trip. 

Providing expert advice and service for robotic and conventional palletisers, bagging
machines, wrapping and hooding machines and their corresponding control systems, you
should expect to spend most of your time working on customer sites, with the remaining time
spent working between the West Heidelberg office and home.


JOB DESCRIPTION


Fundamental Duties and responsibilities 	

Perform in-house and on-site equipment installations and start-ups  
•	Install equipment at customers’ locations according to safety standards and established corporate procedures 
•	Perform initial start-ups for installed equipment
•	Test and verify installed equipment at customers’ locations
•	Perform tests and verify the proper functioning of equipment
•	Train customers on the proper operation of the equipment
•	Prepare reports on completed installations
•	Do in-house equipment start-ups before it leaves for customers’ locations

Solve various equipment problems for customers
•	Visit customers in order to diagnose equipment problems
•	Find solutions in collaboration with the engineering team
•	Adjust and repair customers’ equipment and ensure it is operated safely and according to the original specifications
•	Prepare reports following service calls
•	Contribute to product development

Do preventive equipment maintenance at various customers’ locations
•	Evaluate the safety, general state and compliance of various equipment
•	Do preventive maintenance and repair on equipment
•	Ensure proper equipment functioning following maintenance visits
•	Plan following maintenance visits as needed
•	Provide on-site and/or remote technical support to clients
•	Prepare reports on the work performed

Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Diagnose problems and identify possible solutions for customers
•	Help customers find safe solutions to problems
•	Promote preventive maintenance and training services to customers

Other generic tasks as required
•	Preparing drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists
•	Assisting Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in the design of mechanical equipment and plant
•	Selecting tools and equipment
•	Assembling and installing new and modified mechanical assemblies, components, machine tools and controls, and hydraulic power systems
•	Estimating material costs and quantities, and machine requirements
•	Performing and directing field and laboratory tests
•	Collecting and analysing data, carrying out complex computations and preparing diagrams
•	Organising and supervising inspection and maintenance of machines and plant
•	Ensuring that designs and finished work are within specifications, regulations and contract provisions
•	Prepares detailed drawings and plans of mechanical engineering work in support of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.
 


Advanced Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Assume responsibility for a certain type of service or equipment for customers
•	Do relatively complex installations at customers’ locations
•	Solve complex equipment problems for customers 
•	Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Master preventive maintenance of equipment and suggest improvements to customers during service calls
•	Meet the demand for technical information from potential customers and promote Premier Tech products to customers 


•	Expert Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Be the go-to person for the team as work is carried out
•	Be an instructor and mentor for new team members
•	Collaborate in the equipment design process with the engineering team 
•	Help develop and implement work procedures and methods 
•	Organize installations or repair work to be done
•	Develop and provide specific technical service expertise to the team 
•	Apply different analysis and problem solving skills to diagnose and repair a variety of equipment  
•	Resolve unusual, major and complex problems on customers’ equipment
•	Do major and non-standard equipment installations at customers’ sites




 
COMPETENCIES PROFILE

Qualifications

At least a trade qualification, associate diploma in engineering or suitable equivalent mechanical/electrical/electronic/control automation qualification.

Technical competencies 	

•	In-depth specific knowledge of Premier Tech packaging machinery including Bottom-Up Filling Technology is highly desirable.
•	Interpreting mechanical and general assembly drawings
•	Interpreting hydraulic circuit drawings
•	Interpreting pneumatic circuit drawings
•	Interpreting electrical schematics
•	Interpreting general installation and industrial buildings layouts
•	Industrial PLC, networks and communication protocols
•	installation, commissioning and maintenance of industrial robots, packaging and powder conveying systems.
•	Installation and optimisation of pneumatically operated equipment
•	Installation, commissioning and troubleshooting of field devices and instrumentation
•	Installation and commissioning of industrial machinery safety systems and guarding.
•	Safe troubleshooting of partially energised systems
•	Troubleshooting PLCs programs, mechanical and electrical installations.
•	Systems and equipment start-up
•	Equipment preventative maintenance
•	Service reports generation
•	Training of machine Operators and Maintenance Crews
•	English communication


Culture

As a well-respected and successful business, we have a range of long term, loyal and
committed team members, creating a solid team environment and providing job security. We
work hard but always find time for a laugh. We care about our team and strive to be an
employer of choice!

What’s in it for you?

•	Competitive salary + travel allowance
•	A professional and friendly work environment
•	A hybrid work arrangement with opportunity to work from home or office (as required) when
•	not travelling
•	Fabulous Employee Assistance Program that includes telehealth appointments and
•	extends to immediate family members
•	On-going training and development.

How to apply

Please apply with a current CV and a separate cover letter outlining why you think
you are the right person for this opportunity.

Please note that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted and we thank you in advance for
your time and interest in working with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

result.description:
Network Engineer | Financial services    Your new company     
 Join a high-performing, technology-driven organisation operating in a fast-paced, cloud-first environment where network infrastructure plays a critical role in business success. With ongoing investment into modern networking and cloud capabilities, the business is continuously evolving its platforms to support growth, performance, and security at scale. You'll be part of a collaborative infrastructure team that works closely with engineering groups and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions. 
   Your new role     
 As a Network Engineer, you'll contribute to the ongoing support and enhancement of a complex network environment spanning LAN, WAN, MAN, cloud, and externally facing systems. Working alongside senior engineers, you'll help maintain a stable, high-performing network while also supporting new initiatives and improvements. 
   
 You'll be involved in implementing monitoring and automation to strengthen operational resilience, as well as supporting secure and scalable connectivity across cloud and on-prem platforms. The role offers a balance of BAU responsibilities and project work, giving you exposure to both day-to-day operations and broader infrastructure uplift initiatives. 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Hands-on experience with Cisco and Fortinet technologies across switching, routing, and firewalls (including VDOMs), along with exposure to BGP, VPNs, multicast, and related protocols 
 Experience working in hybrid cloud environments, ideally including AWS (Direct Connect, Transit Gateway) and Azure (ExpressRoute) 
 Background designing and implementing highly available network solutions across multiple connectivity types 
 Exposure to software-defined networking and modern security approaches such as zero trust 
 Around 3-5 years' experience in data networking 
 Exposure to financial services or trading-style environments is beneficial. 
 Familiarity with Linux/Windows servers and tools such as SNMP, Syslog, Datadog, and time synchronisation protocols (NTP/PTP) 
 Experience with network automation and cloud-aligned deployments 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to work in a modern, cloud-first environment with ongoing investment in technology 
 Work from home 2 days per week 
 Exposure to complex, enterprise-scale networking across cloud and on-prem infrastructure 
 A collaborative team culture that values continuous learning and improvement 
 The chance to contribute to meaningful projects while building your technical depth across emerging technologies 
 
  What you need to do now         If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to charlie.pym@hays.com.au   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.

For nearly 25 years, APD Global has set the benchmark in delivering advanced, comprehensive, and specialised engineering solutions.

We have around 800 employees including our alliance contracting partners, across 15 strategically located offices in Australia (Perth, Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide, Darwin), New Zealand and Malaysia. We specialise in seamless integration across the Power Systems, Telecommunications, and Renewable Energy industries. Our expertise spans Power Systems Studies, Transmission Lines, Substations, Telecommunications, Protection, Control & Automation, Renewable Energy Connections, Mining, and Engineering, Protection Panel Design and Installation, 3D Design and Manufacturing as well as Construction/Management (EPC/M) services.

We have outstanding opportunity for an experienced Telecommunications Technologist to join and bring their expertise, integrity, and a positive can-do attitude to our dedicated team of professionals.

Position Overview
The Telecommunications Technologist is responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting telecommunications systems and networks. This position ensures the reliable operation of voice, data, and video communications across the organisation, supporting both internal and external connectivity requirements.

Key Responsibilities
Install, configure, and maintain telecommunications equipment and systems, including routers, switches, fiber optic cables, PBX, VoIP, and wireless technologies
Installing routers, switches, fiber optic cables, and telephone systems
Monitor and optimise the performance of telecommunications networks and troubleshoot issues to ensure optimal operation and minimal downtime
Collaborate with IT and other departments to integrate telecommunications solutions that meet business needs
Conduct tests and measurements on telecommunications equipment and networks
Conduct regular system upgrades and apply security protocols to safeguard communications infrastructure and ensuring compliance with safety standards
Provide technical support and training to end-users regarding telecommunications equipment and services
Document system configurations, network diagrams, maintenance repairs, and procedures for ongoing reference and compliance
Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry best practices

Key Selection Criteria
Relevant tertiary qualifications in telecommunications, information technology, or a related field
Proven experience in managing and maintaining telecommunications networks and systems
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical issues
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-focused approach
Knowledge of Australian telecommunications standards and regulatory requirements

Desirable Attributes
Experience with cloud-based communications platforms
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: Between $80,000 - $100,000 per annum + Super

result.description:
Headquartered in Ontario, Canada, D2L Australia Pty Ltd ("D2L Australia") is an Australian subsidiary of D2L Inc. The business provides a suite of proprietary eLearning software systems/solutions to clients and learners in higher education, schools, healthcare, government and the enterprise sector. D2L Australia is seeking a full time Software Engineer (Product Support Specialist) to provide advanced technical support for our eLearning software by investigating, diagnosing and resolving complex application issues experienced by customers. Acting as the primary technical escalation point for client technical teams, this role will be based in Melbourne (VIC 3000).

Base salary: $79,500 (plus super)

Main Responsibilities:
•	Analyse, diagnose and resolve complex application and technical issues reported by users through systematic investigation and troubleshooting. 
•	Serve as the primary technical escalation point for clients and internal teams, managing high-priority incidents and providing timely resolutions. 
•	Communicate with users via phone, email, chat and case management systems to identify, document and manage technical support requests within defined service levels. 
•	Research technical issues using product documentation, technical manuals and knowledge resources to determine root causes and implement effective solutions or workarounds. 
•	Identify and rectify configuration issues and perform advanced troubleshooting of authentication protocols, APIs, SIS integrations, LTIs and other application integrations. 
•	Develop and execute SQL queries and analyse IIS logs and diagnostic data to investigate application behaviour and accurately report technical findings. 
•	Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate complex issues, identify root causes and recommend appropriate technical solutions. 
•	Contribute to product improvement by preparing software defect reports, feature enhancement requests and identifying trends that support future technical modifications. 
•	Create and maintain technical documentation, including knowledge base articles, FAQs and support documentation for both internal teams and customers. 
•	Monitor and manage support cases by maintaining accurate case records, meeting service level objectives and participating in shift-based operational support.

Required Qualification and Experience:
•	At least a bachelor’s degree in computer science or other relevant fields in information technology or software engineering
•	3 years of work experience in a similar role
•	Customer service experience highly regarded

Ideal Skills and Attributes:
•	Ability to analyse, diagnose and resolve complex software issues through systematic investigation and root cause analysis.
•	Proficiency in web applications, APIs, SOAP/REST services, XML, HTML, Java, C#, .NET, JavaScript, LTI and related technologies.
•	Ability to write and interpret complex SQL queries, analyse IIS logs, and use diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark and Fiddler) to investigate application behaviour.
•	Experience with Active Directory, Office 365, OAuth, LDAP, SAML and related authentication solutions.
•	Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly, collaborate with internal teams and clients, manage escalations, and provide technical guidance and support.
